General:
Eighth International Conference of American States, Lima, December 9–27, 1938:
I. Preliminaries:
(a) Decision not to postpone the Conference
(b) Agenda
(c) Instructions to delegates
II. Proceedings
Chaco dispute between Bolivia and Paraguay: the Chaco Peace Conference
Tender of good offices by the United States, Cuba, and Mexico to conciliate differences between the Dominican Republic and Haiti
Dispute between Guatemala and the United Kingdom
Boundary Disputes:
Argentina and Chile
Ecuador and Peru
Honduras and Nicaragua

Argentina:
Preliminary discussions respecting a trade agreement between the United States and Argentina
Engagement by the Argentine Government of officers of the U. S. Army Air Corps to serve as military aviation instructors; objections of the Brazilian Government

Bolivia:
Informal assistance to the Standard Oil Company of New Jersey in connection with the confiscation of its properties in Bolivia

Brazil:
Efforts of the Department of State to secure equitable treatment for American interests with respect to Brazilian exchange
Representations to the Brazilian Government regarding the suspension of service on certain foreign debts
Representations to the Brazilian Government regarding the German-Brazilian commercial agreement
Establishment of American-Brazilian mixed commissions in New York and Rio de Janeiro for the promotion of trade relations
Operation of the trade agreement between the United States and Brazil
Cooperation of the Government of the United States in checking Nazi activities in Brazil
Agreement between the United States and Brazil providing for a military mission, signed November 12, 1938

Chile:
Provisional commercial agreement between the United States and Chile, signed January 6 and February 1, 1938
Preliminary discussions respecting a trade agreement between the United States and Chile

Colombia:
Expressions of good will and of desire for cooperation between the United States and Colombia
Agreement between the United States and Colombia providing for a military aviation mission, signed November 23, 1938
Agreement between the United States and Colombia providing for a naval mission signed November 23, 1938

Costa Rica:
Attitude of the United States toward the acquisition of Cocos Island from Costa Rica

Cuba:
Discussion regarding a supplemental trade agreement between the United States and Cuba
Assistance of the Department of State in efforts to secure a settlement of the Cuban public works debt

Dominican Republic:
Negotiations for a convention between the United States and the Dominican Republic modifying the convention of December 27, 1924, regarding Dominican customs revenue
Preliminary discussions respecting a trade agreement between the United States and the Dominican Republic

Ecuador:
Reciprocal trade agreement between the United States and Ecuador, signed August 6, 1938
Protection of the interests of the South American Development Company
Protection of interests of the All America Cables, Inc.

El Salvador:
Informal assistance by the Department of State to representatives of the holders of the Salvadoran bonds under the loan contract of June 24, 1922

Haiti:
Agreement between the United States and Haiti providing for the partial suspension of debt payments, signed January 13, 1938, and supplementary agreement providing for an extension of the partial moratorium, signed July 1, 1938
Representations against the inclusion in the Franco-Haitian commercial agreement of provisions regarding the French gold loan of 1910, and failure of the Haitian Government to extend most-favored-nation treatment
Engagement of United States Army Officers to serve as military advisers to the Garde d’Haiti

Honduras:
Reservation by Honduras of claim to sovereignty over Swan Islands described in Navy Department publication as under the dominion of the United States
Attitude of the United States toward the renewal of the commercial treaty between Honduras and Germany

Mexico:
Representations against further expropriation by the Mexican Government of lands owned by American citizens until authorization for payment be made and exchange of notes providing for the settlement of claims arising therefrom
Representations to the Mexican Government regarding the expropriation of oil properties of American companies without providing for adequate compensation
Discussion of an agreement between the United States and Mexico for a lump sum settlement of general claims
Representations against increases in Mexican import tariff rates

Nicaragua:
Agreement between the United States and Nicaragua modifying in certain respects the reciprocal trade agreement of March 11, 1936, signed February 8, 1938
Attitude of the United States regarding proposed amendment to Nicaraguan constitution authorizing treaty for an inter-oceanic canal and proposal for American aid in canalizing the San Juan River
Agreement between the United States and Nicaragua providing for the adjustment of certain accounts of indebtedness and claim for refund of income taxes, signed April 14, 1938

Panama:
Representations to Panama regarding legislation requiring purchase of government bonds by American banking and other institutions
Efforts of the United States Government to prevent the sale of land on Pinas Bay, Panama, to German interests

Peru:
Preliminary discussions respecting a trade agreement between the United States and Peru
Good offices of the Department of State in negotiations to secure a resumption of payments on Peruvian bonds
Engagement of United States naval officers to serve as advisers to the Peruvian Navy

Uruguay:
Preliminary discussions respecting a trade agreement between the United States and Uruguay
Efforts of the Department of State to secure equitable treatment for American interests with respect to Uruguayan exchange restrictions

Venezuela:
Negotiations respecting a trade agreement between the United States and Venezuela; and provisional commercial agreement, signed May 12, 1938
